## Customer Story

**Customer:** Blue Origin - Aerospace manufacturer and spaceflight services company

**Challenge:** Lunar hardware design requires iterative computation-heavy validation cycles that are time-consuming and expensive

**Solution:** Coding agents assisting in the design and validation of lunar hardware components, using long-running computation in sandboxed environments on AgentCore. Agents generate, validate, and iterate on hardware designs autonomously.
